title: Lear takes UFO claims to KLAS; Knapp checks the files

tellings.quote: Um and then he walks in with this UFO madness.

plain: In the late 1980s, a man named John Lear walked into KLAS, a Las Vegas television station, with wild UFO claims, and the station's reporter George Knapp went and checked the files to see whether any of it held up. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell tells this, passing on what was told to him, and also names Ned Day, another Las Vegas journalist of the time. It matters because this is how Las Vegas reporters were first drawn into the UFO story.
